get.description: Use case: the booking cannot be used. Place, dates, guests, rooms and price of the booking.

post.description: Locks price and availability (prebook) and creates the PayPal payment. Send the user to approveUrl, then call /booking-reservations/{id}/booking. 409 OFFER_UNAVAILABLE (search again), 409 PRICE_EXCEEDED, 503 PAYPAL_NOT_CONFIGURED.
Offers from LiteAPI that meet all criteria, ranked by the assistant if available. Takes some seconds. 503 ALTERNATIVES_UNAVAILABLE, 429 ALTERNATIVES_RATE_LIMITED.

get.description: Credit rounded commercially, earnings rounded down (what can be paid out).

parameters.description: ISO 4217 code, defaults to the preferred currency
parameters.name: currency

parameters.name: currency

get.description: Also tells whether PayPal is available on the server.

post.description: Replaces a PayPal account linked before.

400.description: State unknown, expired or of another user (LINK_STATE_INVALID)

409.description: PayPal account linked to another user (PAYPAL_ACCOUNT_IN_USE)

502.description: PayPal refused the code or could not be reached

post.description: Returns the PayPal login URL. PayPal sends the user back to the configured redirect URI with code and state, which the frontend passes to POST /payout-account/paypal within 15 minutes.

get.description: The 20 latest payouts, newest first.

post.description: Debits the earnings and sends the amount to the linked PayPal account. PayPal processes payouts asynchronously: SUBMITTED becomes COMPLETED or FAILED (booked back) later.

409.description: No PayPal account linked (PAYOUT_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED) or earnings too low (INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE)

get.description: The 20 latest top-ups, newest first.

post.description: Creates a PayPal order over the amount. Send the user to approveUrl; PayPal returns to the configured return URL with the order id as query parameter token, then call capture.

422.description: Amount below the minimum or above the maximum (AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE)

503.description: PayPal not configured or no current exchange rate

post.description: After the user cancelled at PayPal. Paid top-ups stay as they are.

parameters.description: PayPal order id, query parameter token of the cancel URL
parameters.name: orderId

404.description: No top-up of the user for this order (TOP_UP_NOT_FOUND)

post.description: Idempotent. Status COMPLETED means credited; PENDING is credited automatically once PayPal releases the money.

parameters.description: PayPal order id, query parameter token of the return URL
parameters.name: orderId

404.description: No top-up of the user for this order (TOP_UP_NOT_FOUND)

post.description: The user plans again by hand. New proposals can be asked for at any time.

Changes the trip: REROUTE and SHIFT_DEPARTURE like PUT /routes/{routeId}/choice, STOPOVER adds a stop at the hotel before the target stop (the route is split), KEEP_ROUTE and TARGET_STAY change nothing. Hotels are booked afterwards, see the answer. Replaces an earlier decision. 409 PROPOSAL_NOT_APPLICABLE (run not finished, trip changed), 400 INVALID_PROPOSAL_INPUT (no such rank).
E.g. after cancelling at PayPal; nothing was paid.

Authorizes the payment, books at LiteAPI, captures the payment and adds the booking to the stop. Safe to repeat. 422 PAYMENT_NOT_APPROVED/PAYMENT_DECLINED, 409 OFFER_UNAVAILABLE (the payment is released), 503 ALTERNATIVES_UNAVAILABLE (try again).
post.summary: Book a reservation after the payment was approved

get.description: Before paying: if the hotel lies in another place than the stop, the arrival on the best way to it (incidents included) and whether it is after the latest check-in. Not stored.
get.summary: Check the way to the hotel of a reservation

delete.description: The booking stays as it is.

post.description: CANCEL also marks the booking as cancelled in the app, the provider is not contacted.

Pasted or shared text and/or a screenshot (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF) or PDF up to 5 MB. The content is sent to the language model (OpenAI) and not stored. 503 ASSISTANT_UNAVAILABLE if the assistant is not configured or fails, 429 ASSISTANT_RATE_LIMITED.
post.summary: Read an accommodation booking from a confirmation

post.description: From the LiteAPI hotel data (with hotelId); missing fields are looked up on the web by the assistant (OpenAI web search, only name, address and coordinates of the accommodation are sent). Counts towards the assistant's rate limit when it is asked.
post.summary: Look up contact and house rules of an accommodation

get.description: LiteAPI hotels whose name contains the query (at least 3 characters). With latitude and longitude (the stop) those within 30 km come first, nearest first. Empty if LiteAPI is not configured or not reachable.
Whether alternatives can be searched, booked, ranked.
Whether confirmations can be read automatically.

post.description: Only in the app, e.g. the booking an alternative replaces; the provider is not contacted.

Cancels at LiteAPI and refunds the PayPal payment (in full while free of charge). Only for alternatives booked in the app. 409 CANCELLATION_NOT_POSSIBLE, 409 OFFER_UNAVAILABLE (LiteAPI refused), 503 ALTERNATIVES_UNAVAILABLE.
post.summary: Cancel a booking made in the app and refund it

get.description: Only TOO_LATE and DELAYED, only trips with at least one.

Also a run started automatically; run is null without.

post.description: Runs in the background and can take minutes, poll the run. If one is already running for the route, its id comes back. 409 NO_ACTIVE_CONSEQUENCE.
post.summary: Start a run of the agent

put.description: Its waypoints replace the waypoints of the route, which is planned again. Waypoints with waypointId stay as they are. With departureAt only the departure at the start stop changes.

post.description: Computed per request and not stored. Without departure or coordinates there are none, see problem.

post.summary: Add an accommodation booking to a stop

post.description: Like an alternative, for a stop without accommodation to replace, e.g. a night on the way taken from a proposal of the agent. The booking is created at the stop. Same errors.
post.summary: Reserve an accommodation at a stop

get.description: Ascending by start, with the phase relative to now.

delete.description: With its stops, routes, waypoints, bookings, title photo and incidents. 409 STOP_IN_USE while an alternative accommodation is being paid at one of its stops.

put.summary: Change name, period and travelers of a trip

get.description: Routes without a run are left out.
get.summary: Last run of every route of a trip

get.description: Payment running (approved at PayPal, booking in progress) or to be checked (NEEDS_ATTENTION); the app shows them so nobody wonders what happened to the money.
Bookings to cancel or to tell about a later arrival after the trip changed, the newest first, also those done.
All bookings at the stops of the trip, ascending by start.
Image bytes, 404 if the trip has none. ETag per photo, 304 on If-None-Match.

put.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB, replaces the current one.

post.description: Drawn by the image model from name and stops (takes a while), replaces a generated photo, keeps an uploaded one. 503 without assistant or if the model fails, 429 over the user's limit.

get.description: Reduced copy (JPEG, at most 768×512) for the trip list; the original if there is no thumbnail (e.g. WebP). 404 if the trip has no photo. ETag per photo, 304 on If-None-Match.

Incidents not ended yet, ranked: TOO_LATE by lateness (not passable first), DELAYED by own delay, NO_IMPACT by passage; ties by earlier passage. Then resolved ones (resolved = true, incident ended), most recently resolved first, until removed.
Per planned route: worst category of its incidents, expected arrival and slack against the arrival at the target stop.
get.summary: Situation of the routes of a trip

get.description: For the map; routes that are not planned (yet) are missing.
get.summary: Planned ways of the routes as lines

delete.description: Only once the incident has ended (resolved = true), 409 INCIDENT_NOT_RESOLVED before; 404 INCIDENT_NOT_FOUND if the route has no consequence of it.
delete.summary: Remove a resolved incident from the trip

post.description: E.g. after ROUTING_UNAVAILABLE, see planOutcome.

put.description: Ordered list: with id changed, without id created, missing ones deleted. The route is planned again.

post.description: Inserted at the position or appended. Routes to its neighbours are created and planned, see planOutcome of the routes.

delete.description: With its bookings and the routes to and from it; its neighbours get a new route, which is planned. 409 STOP_IN_USE while an alternative accommodation is being paid at the stop.

put.description: New coordinates or departure plan the affected routes again.
Routes between new neighbours are created and planned.

AcceptedProposalDto.description: What taking a proposal changed. STOPOVER and TARGET_STAY: book the hotel next, with replacesBookingId via POST /accommodation-bookings/{replacesBookingId}/alternative-reservations, otherwise via POST /stops/{stayStopId}/stay-reservations.

plannedRouteIds.description: Routes planned again; a stopover splits the route, the old one is gone

replacesBookingId.description: TARGET_STAY: the booking the hotel replaces

stayStopId.description: STOPOVER: the new stop at the hotel. TARGET_STAY: the target stop

todosAdded.description: New entries on the to-do list of the trip

AccommodationBookingInputDto.description: Accommodation booking to create or replace. Check-in, check-out and cancellation deadline are local times at the accommodation without offset; the backend determines the time zone from the coordinates and uses fallbackTimeZone (the user's IANA zone) only without coordinates.

source.description: How the booking was entered, default MANUAL

AccommodationDraftDto.description: Accommodation booking read from a confirmation, not stored. found=false: no booking in the input. Times are local at the accommodation, uncertainFields should be checked by the user.

AccommodationDto.description: Place and house rules of an accommodation, times local at the place

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the place, e.g. Europe/Rome

AccommodationFactsDto.description: Contact and house rules of an accommodation, not stored. Times are local at the accommodation. fromLiteApi/fromAssistant name the fields by origin; fields from the assistant were found on the web and should be checked by the user.

researched.description: Whether the assistant looked up missing fields

AccommodationQueryDto.description: Accommodation whose contact and house rules are looked up. hotelId if it was chosen from the suggestions; name, address and coordinates help the assistant identify it.

AccommodationSuggestionDto.description: Accommodation found by name (LiteAPI hotel data), for the autocompletion of the name

AlternativeCandidateDto.description: Offer of a hotel that meets all criteria. price is the total for the stay including the fee.

freeCancellationUntil.description: Free cancellation until then, local at the hotel

possiblySame.description: Within 50 m of the current accommodation, may be the same place

reason.description: Why the assistant ranks it there, absent without ranking

AlternativeCriteriaDto.description: Criteria filled from the booking. Dates local at the accommodation, maxPrice is the total for the stay. missing: fields the user has to enter (location, checkIn, checkOut, guests).

excludeHotelId.description: LiteAPI id of the current accommodation, if known

placeName.description: Address or name the coordinates belong to

AlternativeCriteriaInputDto.description: Criteria of a search. Dates local at the place, maxPrice is the total for the stay including the fee (empty: no limit).

AlternativeSearchResultDto.description: Candidates best first, ranked by the assistant if ranked is true, else by price

offersChecked.description: Offers LiteAPI returned before checking the criteria

AlternativesStatusDto.description: Whether alternatives can be searched (LiteAPI), booked (LiteAPI and PayPal) and ranked (assistant)

payPalClientId.description: Public client id for the PayPal JS SDK, null without PayPal

AssistantStatusDto.description: Whether confirmations can be read automatically (assistant configured)

BookingDto.description: Booking at a stop. Points in time carry the offset of the place (for accommodations: of the accommodation), show them in that local time.

accommodation.description: Details for accommodations, absent for other types

BookingTodoDto.description: Something to do about a booking after the trip changed, with a copy of the booking. CANCEL: cancel it at the provider (bookedInApp: in the app, POST /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-cancellation). NOTIFY_LATE_ARRIVAL: the arrival moves to newArrivalOn, tell the accommodation.

bookedInApp.description: Booked and paid in the app

bookingId.description: null once the booking is deleted, e.g. with its stop

newArrivalOn.description: NOTIFY_LATE_ARRIVAL: day of the new arrival, local

ChoicePointDto.description: Point of a route suggestion that becomes a waypoint when the suggestion is chosen

roadHint.description: Road the point should snap to, e.g. SH 73

waypointId.description: Existing waypoint of the user that stays (includeWaypoints), null: new point

ChosenRouteDto.description: Choice stored: waypoints replaced and the route planned again, read it via GET /trips/{tripId}/routes/{routeId}

planOutcome.description: Outcome of planning, the waypoints stay even if it failed

delaySeconds.description: Expected delay in seconds, null if unknown

CreateStopDto.description: Stop added to the trip, points in time with the offset of the place or the user

position.description: Where to insert the stop, 0 to number of stops; null appends it

CreateTripDto.description: New trip. Points in time with the offset of the user's time zone, e.g. 2027-07-12T00:00:00+02:00

travelers.description: Number of travelers (1-99), suggested as guests of bookings

MoveStopDto.description: New position of a stop, 0 to number of stops - 1

ProposalDto.description: What the agent proposes. REROUTE: send waypoints to PUT /routes/{routeId}/choice. SHIFT_DEPARTURE: send departureAt there. KEEP_ROUTE: nothing to choose. STOPOVER: a night at the hotel in stay, on the way given by waypoints (empty: the planned route), arrivalAt is approximate at the place. TARGET_STAY: another accommodation at the target stop, the route stays.

arrivalAt.description: Including waiting and delays, null if a closure cannot be passed

conflicts.description: Incidents still passed on this way

meetsDeadline.description: Reaches the arrival time of the target stop, null if it has none

reason.description: Written by the model, null without it

sharedRatio.description: Part of the distance shared with the planned route

stay.description: STOPOVER and TARGET_STAY only, absent otherwise

via.description: Main road of the part that differs, e.g. SH 2

ProposalRequestDto.description: Request for a run of the agent

consequenceId.description: Consequence to look at, default: the worst on the route

incidentId.description: Incident to look at instead of the consequence, default: any of the route

ProposalRunDto.description: A run of the agent with its proposals

chosenRank.description: ACCEPTED: rank of the proposal taken

consequenceId.description: Consequence the run is about, null once it was assessed again

decision.description: null while the user has not decided

failure.description: Why the run failed, e.g. ROUTING_UNAVAILABLE

incidentId.description: Incident the run was started for, null if unknown

stale.description: The situation of the route changed since the run started, the numbers may be out of date

summary.description: Written by the model, null without it

ProposalRunStartedDto.description: The run that was started, or the one already running for the route

ProposalStayDto.description: Offer of a hotel as the agent found it. Booking checks it again. With replacesBookingId it is booked like an alternative: POST /accommodation-bookings/{replacesBookingId}/alternative-reservations with hotelId, offerId, checkIn, checkOut, guests, rooms, currency and price as maxPrice. Without it it is booked at the stop of the accepted proposal: POST /stops/{stayStopId}/stay-reservations with the same fields.

place.description: Area or target stop the search looked around

price.description: Total for the stay incl. fee

replacesBookingId.description: TARGET_STAY: the accommodation booked at the target stop that this one replaces

ReferenceRouteDto.description: The planned route evaluated like the suggestions, e.g. "as planned (+45 min)"

blocked.description: Passes a closure during its validity

ReservationDto.description: Booking of an alternative via LiteAPI, paid with PayPal; price (including fee) is what the user pays

approveUrl.description: Approve the payment there, only in the answer that creates it

payPalOrderId.description: PayPal order, for the PayPal button in the app (JS SDK)

refundAmount.description: Refunded with PayPal after a cancellation

refunded.description: The refund with PayPal is made

replannedRouteIds.description: Routes planned again because the stop moved to the place of the new hotel (more than 10 km away), only in the answer that booked it

ReservationInputDto.description: Offer picked from the search with its criteria and the person it is booked for. Name, e-mail and phone go to LiteAPI and are kept only until the booking is made.

RouteChoiceDto.description: The chosen suggestion: its waypoints as returned with it, empty for the fastest way without waypoints

departureAt.description: New departure at the start stop (suggestion of kind DEPARTURE_SHIFT): waypoints are ignored and stay as they are

RouteDetailDto.description: Route with its waypoints in order

planOutcome.description: Outcome of the last planning, null until planned or after a change

plannedAt.description: When the way was last planned, null until planned or after a change of its stops or waypoints

RouteIncidentSummaryDto.description: Situation of a route with its incidents, against the arrival at its target stop

deadline.description: Arrival of the target stop, null: arrival time missing

expectedArrival.description: Arrival with the incidents, null if not passable or not planned

plannedArrival.description: Arrival without incidents, null if not planned

plannedTooLate.description: Even without incidents the arrival is after the deadline

slackMinutes.description: Deadline minus expected arrival in minutes, negative: too late; null without either

unpassable.description: An incident on the route cannot be passed

worstCategory.description: Worst category of its current incidents, null without

RouteLineDto.description: Planned way of a route as a line for the map

geometry.description: Points in WGS84 in driving order

via.description: Roads of the chosen suggestion, e.g. SH 2, null if the route has none

RouteOptionDto.description: One route suggestion, rank 1 is the best. Not stored: to choose it, send its waypoints to PUT /routes/{routeId}/choice

arrivalAt.description: Arrival at the end stop including waiting and delays

conflicts.description: Incidents still passed on this way

durationSeconds.description: Driving time in seconds, without waiting and delays

sharedRatio.description: Part of the distance shared with the planned route (0 to 1), null if not planned

via.description: Main road of the part that differs from the fastest way, e.g. SH 2

waypoints.description: Points that become the waypoints of the route when chosen, in order

RouteProposalRunDto.description: The last run of a route

run.description: Absent if the route has no run

StayRouteCheckDto.description: Way to the hotel of a reservation, checked before paying. Only if the hotel lies in another place than the stop (otherPlace): the stop moves there after booking. Computed, not stored; a hint only.

arrivalAt.description: Arrival on the best way, including delays of incidents

blocked.description: Even the best way passes a closure

checkInUntil.description: Latest check-in at the hotel, if known

otherPlace.description: Hotel more than 10 km from the stop, the stop moves there after booking

problem.description: Why the way was not checked

SuggestionRequestDto.description: Request for route suggestions when planning

departureAt.description: Departure to try instead of the one at the start stop, not stored at the stop

includeWaypoints.description: true: through the waypoints of the route, default false: only between the stops, applying a suggestion then removes the waypoints

SuggestionsDto.description: Route suggestions of a route, computed per request and not stored, or why there are none (problem)

departureAt.description: Departure the suggestions were computed from, null if there is a problem

options.description: Best first, empty if there is a problem

problem.description: MISSING_COORDINATES, MISSING_DEPARTURE or NO_ROUTE, null if there are suggestions

reference.description: The planned route for comparison, null if not planned

waypointMode.description: null if there is a problem

travelers.description: Number of travelers, suggested as guests of bookings

TripIncidentDto.description: Incident affecting a route of a trip, one entry per incident and route; resolved ones (incident ended) until removed

assessedDelayMinutes.description: Own delay on this route in minutes (wait at a closure, delay or assumption), null: not passable

category.description: Effect on the arrival at the target stop, null if not assessed yet

deadline.description: Arrival of the target stop, null without

delayAssumed.description: assessedDelayMinutes is an assumption of the source, show as estimated

delayMinutes.description: Expected delay of the incident in minutes as given, null if unknown

expectedArrival.description: Arrival at the target stop after this incident, null if not passable or not planned

geometry.description: Stretch of the route the incident covers, points in WGS84 in driving order, for the map; empty if unknown

match.description: DIRECT, BY_SHIFT (only hit after earlier delays) or MARGINAL (only within the tolerance of the passage, never TOO_LATE)

passageAt.description: Passage of the affected section, moved by earlier delays

resolved.description: The incident has ended: show as resolved until the traveller removes it

resolvedAt.description: When it was resolved, null if not resolved

timesUnconfirmed.description: Closure whose times are only in the description and could not be read yet: show as "check times"

windowStart.description: Time window of the incident the passage falls into, null without windows

TripProposalRunsDto.description: The last run of every route of a trip that has one

endAt.description: End of the trip (inclusive) with the offset it was entered in

nextStopName.description: Next stop with an arrival in the future

phase.description: Relative to the time of the request

startAt.description: Begin of the trip with the offset it was entered in

UpdateStopDto.description: All fields of a stop, replace the current ones

UpdateTripDto.description: Name, period and travelers of a trip. Points in time with the offset of the user's time zone

travelers.description: Number of travelers (1-99), null removes it

WaypointDto.description: Point the user wants to pass between the two stops of a route

origin.description: USER: chosen by the user, SUGGESTION: created by applying a route suggestion

roadHint.description: Road the point should snap to, e.g. SH 73

WaypointInputDto.description: Waypoint in the ordered list of a route

id.description: Id of an existing waypoint to change, null for a new one

roadHint.description: Road the point should snap to, e.g. SH 73
